resource_name: AURA Contact Center Quality Evaluation Framework
disclaimer: Quality dimension scores are structured analytical signals intended for coaching and operational insight, not automated personnel decisions.

dimensions.name: Next Step Clarity
dimensions.description: Evaluates whether the representative clearly communicated timelines, action items, confirmation references, and post-call expectations.

dimensions.name: Control of the Call
dimensions.description: Assesses whether the representative guided the conversation structuredly, maintained focus, and prevented unnecessary circular dialogue.

dimensions.name: Option Framing
dimensions.description: Measures whether available self-service, payment, dispute, or account resolution options were presented accurately and constructively.

dimensions.name: Objection Handling
dimensions.description: Evaluates how effectively the representative addressed customer pushback, fee questions, policy limits, or dissatisfaction using verified facts.

dimensions.name: Empathy and Tone
dimensions.description: Assesses professional warmth, active acknowledgment of customer frustration or distress, and respectful communication throughout the call.
